Indian Mission Church

Preserved Primary Document • mission.htm

On 27 March, 1884 the land was conveyed by Jesse E. & Elizabeth Joseph to the trustees: Samuel B. Norwood, Whittington Johnson, David P. Street, James H. Clark, Elisha Wright, William A. Johnson & John W. Harmon. The church was formally incorporated on 23 May 1915. A new building was erected in 1921 and called Indian Mission M. P. Church. The oldest grave belongs to Ann Johnson who died on 10/7/1885. Transcriptions were made between 1980 - 2000. The dates have been standardized in format. Entries in quotes are inscriptions copied from the markers. Other entries are comments. The listing is not in strict alphabetical order because I have grouped together individuals appearing on the same grave stone. I have also tried to keep together individuals grouped in the same "plot". A - H I - Z
